description: This file defines various FastAPI endpoints related to customer management within a larger project. It handles operations such as creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving information about customers (end users), as well as blocking/unblocking users and listing customer activities. The endpoints interact with a database via Prisma ORM and include detailed docstrings and parameters for each operation.

methods.name: block_user(data: BlockUsers)
methods.description: API endpoint to block specified users by their user IDs, marking them as blocked in the database.

methods.name: unblock_user(data: BlockUsers)
methods.description: API endpoint to unblock specified users by their user IDs, removing them from the blocked users list.

methods.name: Optional[BudgetNewRequest] new_budget_request(data: NewCustomerRequest)
methods.description: Creates a BudgetNewRequest object based on provided customer request data if budget parameters are specified.

methods.name: new_end_user( data: NewCustomerRequest, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: API endpoint to create a new customer (end user) with optional budget assignment and metadata, inserting into database.

methods.name: end_user_info( end_user_id: str = fastapi.Query( description="End User ID in the request parameters" ), )
methods.description: Retrieves information about an end user given their user ID from the database.

methods.name: update_end_user( data: UpdateCustomerRequest, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Updates an existing end user's details and associated budget, with validation and database operations.

methods.name: delete_end_user( data: DeleteCustomerRequest, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Deletes specified end users from the database based on their user IDs.

methods.name: list_end_user( http_request: Request, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Lists all customer end users, accessible to admin roles, retrieving data from the database.

methods.name: get_customer_daily_activity( end_user_ids: Optional[str] = None, start_date: Optional[str] = None, end_date: Optional[str] = None, model: Optional[str] = None, api_key: Optional[str] = None, page: int = 1, page_size: int = 10, exclude_end_user_ids: Optional[str] = None, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Fetches daily activity metrics for specified customers or all accessible customers, including handling date and model filters.

ctags.name: end_user_info
ctags.signature: ( end_user_id: str = fastapi.Query( description="End User ID in the request parameters" ), )
